appliesTo: auth.users identities, addressed by sha256(uid) truncated to 12 hex characters
note: Identities listed here are not imported into Firebase Auth and get no derived Firestore user document. The classification is deliberately config rather than code so that reversing it is a recorded decision and not an edit. Re-including an identity requires a new explicit operator decision; nothing in the tooling promotes an excluded identity back on its own.
reversal: Remove the fingerprint from this file and regenerate the auth readiness ledger. The excluded identity's derived document is then planned again like any other.

notExcluded.note: Two other example.test identities own profiles and businesses and remain fully included. Domain alone does not decide inclusion; application linkage does.
